init.title: Jarvis response handling
init.description: The Assist pipeline applies no timeout of its own, so this timeout is what keeps a slow Jarvis from wedging voice. Measured on the sentences that actually reach Jarvis, 1 turn in 20 finishes inside 12 s, 11 in 20 inside 30 s and 18 in 20 inside 60 s — a longer timeout answers more turns, at the price of waiting for them. A timeout stops Home Assistant waiting; it does not cancel Jarvis, which may still act afterwards.
